0022600201.text: The LA Clippers (1-7, 1-3 at home) host the New Orleans Pelicans (4-5) in the Clippers' ninth game of the 2026-27 season, as the Clippers come in on a seven-game losing streak and sit 13th in the West. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Isaiah Jackson, Jordan Miller and Yanic Konan Niederhauser, while New Orleans, 11th in the West and on a one-game losing streak, is without Yves Missi. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and their most recent meeting was a 105-99 Clippers loss in New Orleans on March 19, 2026, with no games yet between them this season.
